_comment: The 2D start screen's voice-over. Belongs to no room — VoiceBank loads every bundled script-*.json, so a new scene is a new file. Same format as script-intro.json.

_line_ids._comment: eerste is the short explanation the first time the hub is uncovered. terug is every later visit, including the house button. Three-to-four variants on terug because she will hear it often; two on eerste because she hears it once.
_line_ids.nina.hub.eerste: The first time the start screen is shown, after the title plate and the film.
_line_ids.nina.hub.terug: Every later time she lands on the start screen.

variants.text: Dit zijn mijn kamers. We beginnen in de tuin. Tik maar!
